run_collision_detector: run the collision detector script to visualize Spot robot arm joint torques in real time
get_arm_joints_from_spot: call get_arm_joints_from_spot to extract arm joint names and torque values from the Spot robot

review_get_arm_joints_from_spot: review get_arm_joints_from_spot to understand how it parses arm0 joint states and torque loads
refactor_collision_detector: refactor the collision detector main block to support configurable plot limits and recording intervals
